descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Dezvoltare de software
Department: Product & Engineering 
 Location: Remote - Romania
 Description
 This is a new leadership role at NedGraphics, created to give our Quality Assurance (QA) function dedicated ownership at a senior level. You will lead a team of 5 QA engineers and take full responsibility for quality across our product portfolio, working closely with VP Engineering and the wider R&D team.
AI tooling is increasing the pace and output of our engineering teams. This is an exciting moment to be leading QA: the opportunity is to build a modern, high-performing quality function that keeps pace with accelerating software delivery, expands automation coverage, and raises the bar on what good looks like.
This role is fully remote and open to candidates in the EU and UK.
 Key Responsibilities
 Leadership and Strategy 
Design and own the QA strategy across the NedGraphics and Optitex product portfolios, bringing a clear point of view on what good looks like based on prior experience building QA functions elsewhere
Lead a strategic transformation of the QA function: moving it from its current state to a modern, automation-first, AI-enabled operation, with a credible roadmap and milestones
Build a quality-focused culture within the team and across the wider engineering organisation
Establish clear standards, processes, and quality gates for product releases, informed by best practices from previous roles
Work closely with engineering leads and Product Managers to integrate QA throughout the development lifecycle
Set a clear direction for the team and develop individuals to reach their potential
Act as a hands-on people leader: manage performance, run 1:1s, and support career development for a team of 5
 Automation and Tooling 
Expand automation coverage significantly across the product suite
Set the automation roadmap and direct the existing automation engineer
Identify and introduce AI-assisted testing tools to improve speed and coverage
Progressively reduce reliance on manual regression testing
 Hands-on Testing 
Contribute directly to test design, execution, and defect analysis on complex features
Stay close to the product portfolio to provide well-informed quality judgment
Set the standard for how good testing is done
 Skills, Knowledge and Expertise
 Essential 
Proven experience leading or managing a QA team, ideally having built or significantly transformed a QA function from the ground up
Demonstrated experience building or executing QA strategy, not just following one: you know what good looks like and can point to a track record of setting the direction yourself
Hands-on background in software testing; this is a player-coach role
Solid experience testing native desktop applications
Working knowledge of at least one test automation framework for UI desktop applications (e.g. WinAppDriver, Appium, Squish by Qt Group, or equivalent)
Proficient in Python and shell scripting for building and maintaining test automation
Ability to integrate the automation framework into a wider AI agentic-based build flow, spanning tools such as Azure DevOps, Cursor, and Claude cloud agents
Strong communication skills with the ability to influence engineers, PMs, and senior stakeholders
A track record of improving QA processes and delivering measurable results
Experience working effectively across multiple time zones with a globally distributed team, including asynchronous collaboration and flexible scheduling
Prior experience leading a team, with a clear approach to setting direction, delegating, and developing people
 Desirable 
Experience with AI-assisted testing tools or a genuine interest in adopting them
Background in software product companies, ideally with desktop application portfolios
Exposure to agile or scrum delivery environments
Experience growing an automation capability from the ground up
Familiarity with Azure DevOps for work item tracking, test plans, and pipeline integration
 What We Offer
A new, senior role with real scope to shape how quality is done at NedGraphics
Close collaboration with VP Engineering and a technically strong R&D team
A team of 5 QA engineers to lead and develop
Competitive salary plus 5% discretionary bonus
Flexible working arrangements across EU/UK
